name: Pipan Oils Limited
about: Pipan Oils Limited, an oil and gas company, engages in the exploration, development, and production of oil and natural gas resources in India. It is also involved in the provision of reservoir management; field development; regulatory support; and other services in energy exploration, drilling, production, and field development. The company was formerly known as Omansh Enterprises Limited and changed its name to Pipan Oils Limited in April 2026. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is based in New Delhi, India.
